data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development: the formal 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note in the accounts appears to present NET figures (the report explicitly calls it the prior year's 'net provision'); that note and the managing agent narrative cite a net deterioration of GBP 10.8m. A gross quantitative prior-year movement is not stated in the prior-year movement note, so a gross prior-year development figure was calculated from the GROSS claims development table (claims triangle). The triangle-based gross PYD is +GBP 17.581m (adverse/strengthening) and has been used as prior_year_development_gbp_m (confidence 0.8). The per-line movements taken from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' table are NET-of-reinsurance values per the note and therefore reported in lob_movements with lower confidence. No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior years are listed in the reserves note.
